title: Lentil Tomato Pot
yield_notes: Makes 4 portions. This is fictional starter content, not a cooking report.

ingredients.name: Dry red lentils
ingredients.detail: Rinse in a sieve and drain.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.detail: Wash, peel if needed, and dice into 1 cm pieces.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.detail: Add more if needed to loosen the stew.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.detail: About 1/2 teaspoon; adjust at the table.

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.text: Rinse 200 g lentils. Wash and dice 200 g carrots into 1 cm pieces. Set out 400 g tomatoes, 750 ml water, 15 ml olive oil, 2 g cumin and 3 g salt.

steps.title: Soften the carrots
steps.text: Heat 15 ml olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add 200 g diced carrots; stir for 5 minutes until their edges soften. Reduce heat if they brown rapidly.

steps.title: Simmer the lentils
steps.text: Stir in 2 g cumin for 30 seconds. Add 200 g lentils, 400 g tomatoes, 750 ml water and 3 g salt. Bring to a gentle boil, lower to a simmer and cook uncovered for 18 minutes. Stir occasionally; the lentils should be soft and the stew spoonable.

steps.title: Check the texture
steps.text: Taste a lentil. If still firm, simmer 3–5 minutes more and add a splash of water to prevent sticking. Taste the stew and season at the table.

steps.title: Serve and store
steps.text: Divide into four bowls. Cool reserved portions in shallow containers and refrigerate within two hours. Label the preparation date; freeze portions intended beyond four days.

notes.storage: Refrigerate within two hours in shallow covered containers. Use within four days or freeze promptly.
notes.reheat: Heat stored savory portions until steaming throughout. Stir to eliminate cold spots.
notes.allergens: Check ingredient labels and adapt to your household needs before preparing.
